cell.label: Assess chief complaint, history (duration, depth and ascent protocol). Determine time of symptom onset (descent, ascent, after dive). Take past medical history (PFO, Asthma, coronary artery disease, diabetes mellitus, previous DCS). Perform complete examination. Suspect DCS?
Call Divers Alert Network for recommendations.
Provide advanced life support. Patient stable?
Flat supine position. Oxygen FiO2 at 100%. Isotonic IVF (no dextrose). Call Divers Alert Network for recommendations. Concerns about pneumothorax?
If recompression chamber is available, start hyperbaric oxygen therapy, follow US Navy Tables. If not, transfer to facility where chamber is available.
Keep in ICU, evaluate for other conditions.
